method.method_draft: Read the image as a vertical light-gray curtain covering the left side of a darker tilted rectangle, with only the right portion of the rectangle sticking out. Use the text statement that the whole object is a rectangle. Mentally complete the tilted rectangle behind the curtain by extending its visible straight edges; the covered missing portion has three sides/vertices, so the hidden part is a triangle.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一块浅灰色竖直窗帘，顶部挂在杆上，遮住了左侧区域；窗帘右边露出一部分深灰色、倾斜放置的矩形。可见的深灰色部分有直边从窗帘右侧伸出。推理：题目说明整个物体是一个矩形。把露出的倾斜矩形的上下直边向窗帘后方延长，这些边会在窗帘后形成一个被遮住的尖角区域。这个被遮住的部分由三条边围成，有三个顶点，所以是三角形。
